items.name: Crossbow
items.description: This ranged weapon has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame called a tiller. The tiller has a mechanism to lock the bowstring in place, attached to a trigger mechanism that releases the tension and launches a bolt.

items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Staff of Fire (Greater)
items.description:
This staff resembles a blackened and burned length of ashen wood. It smells faintly of soot and glows as if lit by embers. You can use an Interact action to touch the tip of this staff to a torch, tinder, or a flammable substance to ignite a flame.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ignition]
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Breathe Fire]
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Breathe Fire] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Floating Flame]
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Floating Flame] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fireball]

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

offensiveAbilities.name: Kobold Explosives
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents.

Effect Hezle quickly cobbles together an explosive bomb and lobs it up to 30 feet. All creatures in a 5ft Burst take 5d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Smoky Retreat
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents.

Requirements Hezle must be adjacent to at least one enemy.

Effect Hezle throws a mix of special powders centered on a corner of her space, creating a plume of smoke filling a 5ft Burst until the end of her turn that causes her to be Hidden. She then immediately Sneaks, but must end her movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemies.

All creatures other than Hezle in the smoke cloud must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 3 and Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Hezle deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Staff Mastery
offensiveAbilities.description: Although Hezle does not cast spells, her obsession with fire and long hours of practice allow her to cast spells from her staff of fire as if she had the spells on her spell list and could cast them. She still must expend charges from the staff normally; when she prepares the staff each morning, she is capable of placing 4 charges in the staff.
